source: Released backend tree; no backend diff; CRLF normalized only in disposable Docker build
build: Maven package -pl services/commerce-svc -am -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Djacoco.skip=true; compile/package and formatting gates, not full verify
isolation: Internal Docker network; no published ports; no AWS credentials or outbound access
differences: x86_64 Docker Desktop and JDK image versus ARM64 Fargate JRE
Local PostgreSQL/Redis versus RDS/Valkey TLS and network
Schedulers, event relay and Stripe checkout explicitly off
Standard demo seed only; no real-user data
Diagnostic schedule and JFR overhead, not acceptance workload
